title: Shared Library Catalog
description: Schema for the generated, authoritative sibling listing at catalog/library-index.json. Supersedes specs/004-shared-content-library/contracts/content-catalog.schema.json (renamed content_type field and content-index.json filename); that document remains an unedited historical record of feature 004's original schema, per FR-007. Kept separate from catalog.schema.json (which governs skills): that schema is closed to additional properties and shaped around skill-only fields.
